title: WP84 Decision D endpoint admissibility and density
primary_decision: D2 — quantitatively sufficient admissible density proved for the direct first-strike endpoint-score consumer

endpoint_score_bound.hypothesis: finite fixed-R direct-consumer feature score; integral sum_(n<=N)|a_n(theta)|^2 dtheta <= C_R; all prime powers retained
endpoint_score_bound.markov_sets: lower and upper score-good endpoint sets each have uniform density at least 1/2 at O_R(1) thresholds
endpoint_score_bound.joint_pair_density: gamma_T >= 1/4 in the exact Decision B uniform pair measure

joint_boundary_selection.correlation_assumption: none; uses E>=0 and G subset W
joint_boundary_selection.weighted_measure_warning: for a nonuniform pair measure use weighted mass gamma=sum_G omega_uv, not unweighted cardinality density

boundary_transfer.conclusion_at_gamma_ge_1_4: normalized complete cubic boundary correction=o(1) on a jointly endpoint-admissible section

scope_firewall.covered: direct first-strike finite generic endpoint-feature scores defined in WP84_GOOD_ENDPOINT_TRIMMING.md
scope_firewall.source_mask: not a premise of direct inequality (12)
